decisions.reason: Given the investment in the 518 FLEX rebranding and its established position, management persists to justify the commitment and sees no clear negative results.
The trade-fair launch of the whole AK series with EU Stage V engines signals heavy investment and public visibility, making withdrawal highly unlikely.
The product gained its own page, indicating growing commitment, and without clear disappointing results the firm continues resource deployment rather than admit failure.
The new CERON generation is presented as setting standards, representing strong public commitment and invested resources, so escalation logic strongly favors keeping it.
